title: Pricing — missing preparatory/causal works: mould treated but the leak behind it not addressed
why: Mould to a wall with an evidenced leak behind it (reading profile, staining below the cistern). MOULD-WALL alone treats the symptom; the remedy must address the cause (LEAK-TRACE) or be framed as investigation first. Price-book note on MOULD-WALL says exactly this.

room.name: Bathroom
room.note: Mould and staining to the wall behind and below the WC cistern, staining has a defined lower edge. 48% at the stain, 13% at the other side of the room. Cistern overflow connection looks wet.

transcripts: Bathroom, behind the toilet, mould and staining behind and below the cistern, defined edge to the stain. Forty eight percent there, thirteen the other side of the room. The connection on the cistern looks wet to me.

must_not_happen.label: mould treatment is not proposed without the leak being addressed
no ventilation remedy for a leak

allowed_uncertainty: LEAK-TRACE + MOULD-WALL, or investigation_first with LEAK-TRACE alone.
reviewer_notes: Playbook: 'Remedial always addresses the cause first, then the finish.'
